notablePrerequisites:
You control up to two lands that can tap to produce at least {1}{U}.
Either Quickling or Faerie Impostor must be in your hand, with the other on the battlefield.
description:
Activate up to two lands by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}.
Cast Cloud of Faeries by paying {1}{U}.
Reflections of Littjara triggers, copying Cloud of Faeries.
Resolve the copy of the Cloud of Faeries spell, creating a token copy of it.
When the Cloud of Faeries token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to two lands.
Activate up to two lands by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}.
Resolve the original Cloud of Faeries spell.
When Cloud of Faeries enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to two lands.
Cast either Quickling or Faerie Impostor from your hand by paying its mana cost.
Reflections of Littjara triggers, copying the Quickling or Faerie Impostor spell.
Resolve the copy of the Quickling or Faerie Impostor spell, creating a token copy of it.
When the Quickling or Faerie Impostor token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Quickling or Faerie Impostor from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the original Quickling or Faerie Impostor spell.
When Quickling or Faerie Impostor enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Cloud of Faeries from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
